projects.title: The Fluted Wall
projects.summary: A family flat built around one long wall of fluted walnut, with a navy kitchen and a bar counter where the day starts and ends.
projects.brief: A home that felt warm rather than showroom-cold, with a proper media wall for the living room, a hard-working kitchen and a nursery that could grow with the family.
projects.response: Fluted walnut panels run from the entrance through the living room and wrap the kitchen island, tying the rooms together. Navy cabinetry and a marble-look backsplash keep the kitchen crisp, while backlit display niches and a tufted headboard soften the bedrooms.

gallery.alt: Living room with fluted walnut media wall
Kitchen run in navy with marble-look surfaces
Backlit display shelving beside the television
Bathroom with floating vanity and fluted panel

projects.title: The Country Kitchen
projects.summary: A shaker kitchen with handmade tiles, brass pendants and an oxblood glazed door, in a flat that feels like a cottage twelve storeys up.
projects.brief: A couple with a clear picture: a kitchen they would actually cook in, a soft green bedroom, and none of the glossy surfaces that come with most new flats.
projects.response: The kitchen is the heart of the plan, with cream shaker cabinetry, a farmhouse sink and open shelves under a run of warm lighting. Handmade-look subway tiles and brass fittings carry the character; the sage bedroom and a compact service yard follow the same restraint.

gallery.alt: Farmhouse sink beneath the kitchen window

projects.title: The Garden Room
projects.summary: A ground-floor condominium apartment that opens onto a bamboo-screened patio, with a white shaker kitchen and walnut throughout.
projects.brief: Make the most of the private outdoor space and give the family a kitchen big enough to cook together in.
projects.response: The kitchen was reworked with white shaker cabinetry, a stone splashback and a hanging rack for pans. Outside, a bamboo screen and timber loungers turn the patio into an extra room, and cove lighting along the ceiling ties the interior together after dark.

gallery.alt: Patio with bamboo screen and loungers
Living room opening to the garden

projects.title: Stone and Brass
projects.summary: Grey stone-textured joinery, brass detailing and a cluster of pendants over the dining table give this flat the calm of a hotel suite.
projects.brief: An owner who wanted a darker, more grown-up palette than the usual white flat, with generous storage that would not read as cupboards.
projects.response: Full-height stone-effect panels conceal wardrobes and services so the walls read as one surface. Brass inlays, a backlit display cabinet and a pendant cluster over the table add the warmth; a walk-in wardrobe behind smoked glass keeps the bedroom uncluttered.

gallery.alt: Dining table beneath a pendant cluster
Kitchen and dining as one room
Stone-textured feature wall with concealed storage

projects.title: Tanglin Regency
projects.summary: Dark timber panelling, a mirrored dining wall and a backlit headboard give this apartment a hushed, evening feel.
projects.brief: A polished, hotel-like apartment for entertaining, with a bedroom that felt like a retreat.
projects.response: Walnut panelling and a mirrored wall stretch the living and dining space; concealed lighting in the ceiling and behind the headboard does most of the work after dark. A compact coffee pantry sits behind glass by the entrance.

projects.title: Limewash and Walnut
projects.summary: Limewashed walls, walnut furniture and a black steel-framed glass partition turn a standard flat into something closer to a loft.
projects.brief: Owners who collect objects and plants, and wanted a textured, lived-in backdrop that would let those things be the decoration.
projects.response: Every wall is finished in a mottled limewash so the flat reads as one continuous material. A black steel and glass partition separates the bedroom without closing it off, and a thin line of light replaces the usual ceiling fittings.

gallery.alt: Living room with arched mirror and plants
Steel-framed glass partition to the bedroom

projects.title: Soft Curves
projects.summary: A curved, cove-lit wall wraps the dining area of this flat, with terrazzo underfoot and a calm, tonal bedroom.
projects.brief: A quiet, uncluttered flat with as few hard edges as possible.
projects.response: A curved plaster wall with a concealed light cove softens the dining space. The bedroom is finished in a single tone with a floating headboard ledge, and the bathroom pairs terrazzo with a walnut vanity.

gallery.alt: Bathroom with terrazzo and walnut vanity

projects.title: Tengah Drive
projects.summary: A grey monochrome flat with a black kitchen, cove lighting and a dedicated gaming room.
projects.brief: A clean, contemporary flat in greys, with a proper room for gaming and work.
projects.response: Charcoal kitchen cabinetry, a sculptural pendant over the dining table and cove lighting around the ceiling set the tone. Grey full-height storage keeps the living room clear.

projects.title: Koun Patisserie
projects.summary: A patisserie fit-out in navy and oak, with an arched fluted backdrop and long runs of lit display shelving.
projects.brief: A bright, orderly shopfront with display that shows the bakes at their best.
projects.response: Oak-fronted display cases with integrated lighting run the length of the shop, against a navy counter and an arched fluted feature behind the till.

services.title: Interior design
services.desc: Concept, spatial planning and detailed design for the whole home, from the first sketch to the last drawer pull.

services.title: Design & build
services.desc: One team carries the design through construction, so decisions on paper and decisions on site never disagree.

services.title: Renovation
services.desc: Full and partial renovations for HDB, BTO, condominium and landed homes, handled within the relevant guidelines.

services.title: Custom carpentry
services.desc: Joinery designed for the specific room and the specific person, made to measure rather than off the shelf.

services.title: Project management
services.desc: Schedules, site supervision and communication, so you know what is happening and when, without chasing.

steps.title: Conversation
steps.text: We start with your home, your routines and your budget. Site visit, measurements, and an honest discussion about what is possible.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Plans first, then materials, then detail. You see the whole home drawn before anything is built, and the cost alongside it.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Our own team takes the drawings to site. One point of contact, a clear programme, and checks at every stage.

steps.title: Handover
steps.text: A walk-through together, a defects check, and the keys to a home that matches the drawings you approved.
